[size=3][color=#ff7700]This is a FS module, you need to go to Pierre to buy the hand mirror and get it through the hand mirror.If you have any questions about the FS module, please go to the fashion sense module page for reference.

Almost all objects have animation effects and motion dynamics, but only adapt to the static, sitting and running positions of the characters. So when performing other actions, they may encounter issues such as texture misalignment.

Another known issue at present is that characters wearing high-definition items while riding horses may experience severe texture misalignment, which cannot be solved solely by my abilities.[/color]

[color=#00ffff][size=4]Need[/size][/color]
[color=#efefef][size=3]SMAPI, Fashion sense，More Elegant Farmer body（recommend）[/size][/color]

[color=#00ffff][size=4]Install[/size][/color]
[color=#efefef][size=3]1.Download and install all required.[/size]
[size=3]2.Download the pack and unzip it.[/size]
[size=3]3.Put the folder in "Mods".

[/size][/color][/size][size=4]Important[/size]
[size=3]1.This pack fits into another mod of mine. [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7331]click here[/url]

[size=3]4. Please do not transfer/resell/integrate my mods, nor do you pay for unauthorized mod files under any pretext for the sake of convenience.

Enjoy eating~
